description:
Cast Gemcutter Buccaneer by paying {3}{R}. When it enters, Gemcutter Buccaneer triggers, creating a tapped Treasure token that enters as an Equipment.
When the Treasure enters, Sokka and Suki triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token which enters as a Pirate due to Conspiracy.
When the Ally enters, Gemcutter Buccaneer triggers, creating a tapped Treasure token that enters as an Equipment.
Repeat from step 2.
